title: Share immutable compiled code, not live playback state

definition.title: Share immutable compiled code, not live playback state
definition.source_excerpt: Startup · New packaging/cache hypothesis · P1 · Risk: Medium First environment: Browser first; build variants later. Dependencies: None; verify prerequisites locally. Status: Untested hypothesis. Proposed mechanism. Use single-flight loading of hash-identified Wasm modules and optional shader/font assets. Create fresh mutable instances for each source. Consider a small decode-only/prepare-only module split only when measured startup justifies its packaging complexity. Source basis. Official WebAssembly guidance discusses separating compilation from instantiation and worker reuse. Demuxe already has optional plan prerequisites; module availability should be explicit rather than an undocumented local-build dependency. [E2, D1]
definition.impact_basis: Potentially removes substantial work from an eligible playback, seek, preparation, retention or repeated interaction. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Read the supplied local follow-up and verify the named raw record once if accessible. Carry forward its scoped disposition; do not rerun this profile just to populate this ledger. Later cache/asset/memory/cancellation confirmation; do not automatically start a large confirmation campaign during breadth-first screening.
definition.minimum_probe: One short action trace through existing code with the candidate disabled/enabled; include the specific seek, cancellation or replacement transition it can affect.
definition.initial_screen: Trace the precise owner, generation, reset/flush/commit or allocation being changed. Reproduce the present behavior before removing any guard. One short action trace through existing code with the candidate disabled/enabled; include the specific seek, cancellation or replacement transition it can affect.
definition.primary_metric: User-visible operation latency, duplicated work or peak/steady live resource ownership; not object counts alone.
definition.scope_contract: Actual output identity and timeline, surviving consumers, committed generations and cleanup; candidate execution must be visible.
definition.negative_control: Cancel or replace a source at the changed boundary and delay a stale callback/consumer; reject late publication and premature reuse.
definition.stop_boundary: At the first need for a cross-backend ownership redesign, record DEFER_SETUP. Do not remove a semantically required reset or increase a timeout to hide a failure.
definition.shared_prerequisite: Relevant existing runtime/owner only. Do not require every other backend to pass before this independent screen.
definition.reopen_condition: Later cache/asset/memory/cancellation confirmation; do not automatically start a large confirmation campaign during breadth-first screening.
definition.relevance_basis: Editorial fit to ordinary Demuxe playback goals, not measured prevalence; rerank after one local opportunity audit.
